German New Medicine (GNM) Conflict Resolution

Therapy gnm ghk conflict-medicine phase-specific resolution

Evidence: opinion

Summary

German New Medicine approach focused on identifying and resolving biological conflicts. Each symptom has a specific GNM-conflict meaning and phase-appropriate treatment timing. Uses conflict-resolution techniques, phase tracking, and phase-corrective interventions.

Type: gnm

Benefits

  • Conflict identification and resolution
  • Phase-correct treatment timing
  • Symptom understanding through GNM lens
  • Natural healing cycle completion

Contraindications

  • Severe psychiatric conditions (without integrated care)
  • Active psychosis (requires clinical support)

Session Duration: 60-120 minutes per session

Frequency Recommendation: Weekly or bi-weekly during active resolution; monthly for maintenance

Cost Range: $150-500 per session
